housing.summary: Lugano is the largest Italian-speaking Swiss city and a financial centre in Ticino. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 1,408/month per Numbeo (Aug 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need valid ID, proof of Swiss residence registration (iscrizione anagrafica), and permit (non-EU). Main banks in Lugano: UBS and Banca Cantonale Ticinese (Banca dello Stato del Cantone Ticino, bancastato.ch). Lugano hosts several private and international banks given its financial services sector.
required_docs: Proof of Swiss address registration (iscrizione anagrafica)
Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)
banks_named: Banca dello Stato del Cantone Ticino (bancastato.ch)

schools.summary: Lugano's Italian-speaking environment means local public schools follow Swiss Italian curriculum. International schools in Lugano include Lugano International School (LIS) offering IB, and several other private institutions. Cross-border proximity to Italy also provides access to Italian liceo options.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the Ufficio controllo abitanti of their Lugano municipality within 8 days of arrival in canton Ticino (stricter than federal 14-day rule). EU/EFTA nationals register for permit B or L at the Sezione della popolazione (cantonal migration office). Non-EU nationals need a cantonal permit. Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: The AHV-Nummer (OASI number / numero AVS) serves as the Swiss tax and social insurance ID, assigned by the Cassa cantonale di compensazione (cantonal office in Ticino) or employer. Ticino has moderate cantonal tax rates. Cross-border workers (frontalieri) from Italy are subject to specific bilateral tax agreements. Withholding tax applies for foreign residents without a C-permit.

transport.summary: Lugano's public transport is operated by TPL Lugano (Ticino Public Transport), including bus network and the Lugano funicular. A monthly zone pass costs approximately CHF 64 per Numbeo data. EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Sezione della circolazione (Lugano) without a driving test. Mandatory assicurazione malattia (Krankenversicherung) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/UFSP.
transport.network_name: TPL Lugano (Ticino Public Transport / Lugano bus network)
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at Sezione della circolazione Ticino (ti.ch/circolazione); non-EU licences generally require theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (assicurazione malattia/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
